title: Airfiles
summary: Network files transfer tool on the CardputerZero from SmartPhones & PC's.
description:
Network file transfer tool on the M5Stack CardputerZero from SmartPhone or any computer.

Airfiles puts a QR code and a PIN on the CardputerZero's 320x170 screen. Scan the code with a phone, pick files in the browser, and they land in ~/Airfiles on the device. No app is needed on the phone, and it works the same for iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux and curl with API supported.
